parameters.name: Commit
parameters.description:
Whether to commit.
false: Not actually saved, only checked
true: Commit and save

parameters.name: WordInfoListModified
parameters.description: Whether the keyword information has been modified.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rai update-word-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --group-id 1 --group-name '测试分组' --word-info-list-modified true --commit true --body-data '{"WordInfoList":[{"Word":"投资","Label":"业务敏感"}]}' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rai UpdateWordGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName '测试分组' --Commit true --BodyData '{"WordInfoList":[{"Word":"投资","Label":"业务敏感"}]}' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --WordInfoListModified true --GroupId 1
